senses.gloss: m. ch. (= b. h. חָצָץ, v. חָצָץ, end) gravel, sand.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 20:17">Targ. Prov. XX, 17</cite> (Ms. <cite ref="H01526"><he>חֲצִיצָא</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>חֲצָצֵי</he>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joh. 1) <he>סגיתון בטורי בח׳ וכ׳</he> you have to walk over rocks and gravel without shoes &c.
